description: Estimates the door-to-door landed cost in INR of importing goods from China to India with IFC: invoice value, IFC freight/clearance/delivery, insurance, customs duties (BCD, SWS, AIDC) and IGST, using the same engine as the calculator on importsfromchina.com. Estimate only; IFC confirms the final quote. Give weight_kg, cbm or both. If one is not known, leave it out and IFC uses an approximate figure for it (approx idea only; use the exact values from the supplier if available).

cartons.description: Optional number of cartons (improves the CBM estimate when cbm is not given)

cbm.description: Total volume in cubic metres. Optional: if left out, IFC estimates it from weight_kg and the product type.

invoice_value.description: Supplier invoice value in the chosen currency

product_name.description: Optional product name for the cost sheet

weight_kg.description: Total gross weight in kg. Optional if cbm is given (then an approximate weight is used).

name: estimate_landed_cost
title: Estimate China to India landed cost
